resolutions.researcher_notes: 'Okaz' = the Akkas/Akaz gas field (عكاس/عكاز) in western Al-Anbar; GEM segment 'K3-Al-Anbar' is the dry-gas transmission line delivering Akkas-field gas to the ~1,640 MW Al-Anbar Combined Cycle Power Plant (Ministry of Oil, 24 in). RE-CHECK of the dead-link current_ref (iraqieconomists.net Al-Jibawi PDF): the file is live (HTTP 200) but its extracted text contains no mention of Okaz/Akkas or this pipeline, so it does NOT corroborate the value — dropped. FOUND corroboration for the 'proposed' status: attaqa.net (Al-Taqa, 2025-10-04) and mustaqbl.net both report, in near-identical wording, that 'the Council of Ministers recently referred/approved for execution the project to construct the fuel pipeline transporting from the Akkas gas field to the [Anbar] plant site' (مجلس الوزراء أحال/وافق مؤخراً مشروع إنشاء أنبوب الوقود الناقل من حقل عكاس الغازي إلى موقع المحطة للتنفيذ) — i.e. the transmission line is at the cabinet-authorization / pre-construction stage while the plant itself is ~95% complete and awaiting Akkas field development. This supports 'proposed'. CAVEAT / tier=medium: the two Oct-2025 items are different outlets but clearly trace to the same cabinet announcement, so they are not fully independent; corroborating English reporting (Iraq Business News, 2025-08-22, 'Iraq Authorises Pipeline Extension Contract with SEPCOIII' — 250 km dry-gas line to the Anbar plant) exists but is behind a 401 bot-block and could not be verified. MILD DISAGREEMENT FLAG: with the SEPCOIII/SEPCO-III addendum authorized (Aug 2025) and the project 'referred for execution', by mid-2026 this segment may be transitioning from 'proposed' toward 'construction' — worth re-checking against a construction-start source. Note also a separate, shorter 30 km line was laid to the Akkas 250 MW gas power station (محطة عكاز), distinct from this transmission segment.
